title: Are you unhappy at work?
questions: What are the main ideas you learned from this episode? Please give a brief summary in your own words.
How can you tell whether unhappiness at work comes from the job itself or from temporary stress?
Which is a stronger reason to leave a job: poor management, boring work, low pay, or lack of growth?
Should people stay in a secure job they dislike if changing jobs involves financial risk?
How much responsibility does an employer have for employees' happiness?
What would need to change in a job you disliked before you decided to stay?
